from checkconf import main


def test_main_reports_an_unknown_key(tmp_path, capsys):
    settings = tmp_path / 'service.conf'
    settings.write_text('name = web\ncolour = red\n')
    main([str(settings)])
    assert capsys.readouterr().out == 'unknown key: colour\n'


def test_main_returns_1_for_an_unknown_key(tmp_path):
    settings = tmp_path / 'service.conf'
    settings.write_text('name = web\ncolour = red\n')
    assert main([str(settings)]) == 1


def test_main_returns_0_and_prints_nothing_for_known_keys(tmp_path, capsys):
    settings = tmp_path / 'service.conf'
    settings.write_text('name = web\nport = 80\ndebug = on\n')
    assert main([str(settings)]) == 0
    assert capsys.readouterr().out == ''


def test_main_reports_each_unknown_key_in_order(tmp_path, capsys):
    settings = tmp_path / 'service.conf'
    settings.write_text('colour = red\nport = 80\nsize = 3\n')
    assert main([str(settings)]) == 1
    assert capsys.readouterr().out == 'unknown key: colour\nunknown key: size\n'


def test_main_returns_0_for_an_empty_file(tmp_path, capsys):
    settings = tmp_path / 'service.conf'
    settings.write_text('')
    assert main([str(settings)]) == 0
    assert capsys.readouterr().out == ''
EOF

cat > checkconf.py <<'EOF'
KNOWN_KEYS = {'name', 'port', 'debug'}


def main(argv):
    status = 0
    with open(argv[0]) as settings:
        for line in settings:
            if not line.strip():
                continue
            key = line.partition('=')[0].strip()
            if key not in KNOWN_KEYS:
                print(f'unknown key: {key}')
                status = 1
    return status
EOF
